title: I am intending to destroy Batil and the Sultanate of Shaitan
body:
Destur, ya Sayidi, Meded. Shukr, ya Rabbi…Tauba, ya Rabbi…
I am intending to destroy Batil and the Sultanate of Shaitan! My intention is to establish the heavenly
kingdom on earth in East and West, North and South, overseas and on continents, to be said everywhere: La
ilaha ill-Allah, Muhammad Rasulullah!
You should be granted according to your intention, not according to your actions. We say: ‘Audhu bi-llahi
mina shaitani rajim’, ‘Ya Rabbi, protect us from the dog Shaitan’. He is attacking everyone, even its owner;
sometimes a dog eats its owner. So dangerous. He is coming silently, and then he bites. You can’t trust on
dogs now. There are some good qualities that they carry, but don’t trust. They are not like cats, making miau,
miau, coming friendly, rubbing themselves on you, waiting for food. Dogs, if they are hungry, never sit there.
If they see something in a child’s hand, they come around. The child is heedless, and then the dog catches the
bread from his hand and runs away. Doesn’t matter; Sadaqa… Don’t keep dogs. Dogs may be for countryside,
for some purposes or through gardens as a guardian, it doesn’t matter; but don’t put dogs inside; make them
away from your cities.
Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim; that is our sword or our divine code-number that you may use for every aim

and it opens. Nothing can be closed or locked up, if you say the Besmela; it must open. Bismillahi-r-Rahmanir-Rahim opens every locked treasure and helps servants to make easy what they are asking to do, because, as
Allah is saying: ’We created man weak’, and a weak person needs help.
I am weak now, and when I am asking to stand up, two people carry me up. That is help for me, because I am
weak. And man also is created weak, but Allah granted to them from His endless power oceans, according to
what they may be in need on their levels, to use Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim. Therefore the Prophet said:
’Without using the Besmela anything you ask to do can’t reach a success or a successful result. There is no
opening. If you work on it from beginning of Dunya up to end- it is not going to open by your power or your
will; your capacity is not enough. But when you use Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim, it quickly opens. You
must know the power of the Besmela; endless power for every purpose. You may use Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-rRahim for every purpose, and everything must bow, when you say it; nothing is going to refuse, when a
person says: Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim. Ali Baba was saying ‘Simsalabim’ and that opened the treasure.
What is the foolishness of the Muslim world not to use Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim? It is biggest power.
Endless power oceans you have been granted and you are not using, but you say: Crisis, crisis, and crisis.
Yesterday I was looking to the newspaper and they said good news: Through our galaxy they found an old
star with billions of tons of gold on it. It is like a peak of gold, shining… Ohh, I must prepare sacks for the
gold to fall in it! Very happy! For those foolish people who say: ‘Crisis, crisis’, that is good tidings. It is an old
star. If it was not old, that gold mine can’t be there. On earth you find only a little bit. Now people say:
Alhamdulillah. It is a gigantic star, bigger than our sun also… Ohhh, I can’t sleep whole night! (Sheikh is
laughing) Where we shall put that gold? Our earth will get heavy, may fall down. To where? I don’t know…
They say that our earth is going to go under that star; raining down gold- open your sacks to fall and run on
you that gold…I can’t sleep whole night, good tidings!
And this star- no hope for it to use that gold; it is asking to throw it away, to be free. More clever than earth
people. That star is saying: ’I am fed up to carry that gold, I shall throw it away.’ Even one peak is enough, but
there are billions on it. I am saying: ’Keep yourself until we come under you.’ Good tidings for ladies alsoputting bracelets from here to there that they can’t stand up from the heaviness of gold… We are saying: ‘We
are poor people, you are a rich star, send us.’ It is five times bigger than the earth… The distance? 1oo.ooo
light years… Doesn’t matter, we may take good tidings... You prepare that we pass safely, but you must take.

I must write this to the President of America also: ‘Don’t worry, print new Dollars, and say: ‘For every Dollar
we put gold through that star. It is security for every bank note. We put the gold there, because thieves may
take it from here. There it is safe, never going to fall the Dollar, but every time going up, because the star is
security for your Dollars.’
Subhanallahi-l ‘Aliyu-l ‘Azim!
Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim. We say this, because we are so weak; it is impossible through our weakness
to reach to that star. But a ‘Mutasarrif’, someone who has been granted will from the divine Will to do
something, before he says anything, may come already from that star as much as he is asking. By ordinary
means it is impossible to reach there. But in a blink of eye, if he is asking, that Qutb-ul-Mutasarrif may fill a
hill with gold- it is not difficult- bringing it here. I may say: ’Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim, I am asking an
amount for the Baraka of the Besmela.’ Its power runs through the universe everywhere. There are some
places with all blue stars, full with precious blue stones, some other places with red stars of red stones, or
green stars with green emeralds- and there are countless colours and countless precious stones through this
universe. We only know some kinds here. From any kind that Qutb-ul-Mutasarrif may bring here.
You must believe in Allah! He created you and made you Khalifa, giving to you that power to use, to be able to
establish the Sultanate on behalf of the Name of Allah through the whole universe. You have been granted
such a power; it may come to you when you are asking. Hazreti insan; man is glorified, but people are like
mules, like cattle, only looking on grass, what they are eating, asking pleasure for their physical body, never
taking care for their real personality.
Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim. We are in depthless weakness, that is our position, but endless power oceans
have been granted to you to use. Be with Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim; you are granted to use it. But man
in our days never asks to move from the sewage. How people can reach Heavens if they ask to live through
the sewage? How they can get out to a clean area and go up? All people are so happy to be in the dirty sewage,
and everyone in it is going to be dirty also. And dirtiness can’t reach to the glory of Heavens.
This is a Mescid, a mosque. You can’t get in without cleaning yourself. We built this building here for the
honour of the Lord, to fulfil His divine orders to pray, and we are in need cleanliness to come in it, because it
is a prayer-hall. What about through Heavens? And you are in the sewage. How you can go there and you

insist to be in the sewage? You must get out and you must clean yourself. And you have been granted wings
from the power ocean, carrying you through every distance, in every direction. To where you are asking to
reach, you may reach. Therefore we are in need of that cleanliness, but people are happy to be in the sewage,
so they should be there and die there.
May Allah forgive us and clean us. He is saying about cleaning: ’I am sending My guidance, I am showing you
how you can get out from the sewage. Use that way to save yourself, to come up; you should be clean and
reach to any of your target, will or wish.’ Therefore tahara, cleanliness, is the first order in Islam. Who says:
‘La ilaha ill-Allah, Muhammad Rasulullah’, just he cleaned his soul; and then comes the order to go and make
Ghussl for his body. After saying the Shahada, the second obligation is to wash oneself. And after washing the
physical body we are in need to complete that cleaning through those people, who are experts in this- the
Anbiya and Awliya, prophets and saints…
O Allah, send us people who may clean us to make us prepared to be welcome and suitable servants for your
divine service. And may You give more from Your light and honour and glory oceans to the most glorified
servant S. Muhammad sws.
Lefke - 19.01.2002
